column1: # Import map for scripts/gamevault-import.py — source path, then the name
# GameVault should serve it under.
# Started from `gamevault-import.py propose` and corrected by hand. IGDB's
# first match got roughly half of these right; it invented an Assassin's Creed
# bundle from 2020 for the 2007 game and mapped three separate Monkey Island
# discs onto three chapters of Tales of Monkey Island, so nothing here is
# machine-decided.
# Naming rules that are not optional. GameVault parses round brackets as flags
# — (v1.2) is a version, (2009) is a year, (EarlyAccess) is a flag — so a
# subtitle or edition goes in square brackets, and the parse is case
# sensitive. Colons are dropped rather than escaped.
# Commented-out lines are deliberate. They stay in _ADRIAN until someone
# decides what they are. Uncomment to import.
